source_text: Post transitum maris et cantica venitur ad Merram. Sitivit populus; aquae amarae. Ibi posuit Deus iustitias et iudicia. Non sine tentatione disciplina.
pass_a_gloss: After crossing of-sea and songs one-comes to Marah. Thirsted people; waters bitter. There placed God justices and judgments. Not without trial training.
pass_b_english: After the sea and the victory songs comes [[Marah >> Bible:Exodus 15:23]]. The people thirst; the waters are bitter. There God [[set statutes and judgments >> Bible:Exodus 15:25]]. Training does not arrive without trial.
